subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core own a new Rust interactive launcher menu, or should launch ergonomics stay in the existing CLI, onboarding, web, and companion-app surfaces for now?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical correctness; this PR adds a new user-facing setup/startup and Rust build surface that needs product ownership before repair automation is worth applying.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
options.body: Keep the direction alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, delegates configured readiness/version behavior, wires build/package support, forwards exact CLI args, and proves real flows.

options.title: Decline core launcher for now
options.body: Pause or close this PR and direct launch ergonomics toward existing onboarding and companion-app work until maintainers explicitly sponsor the surface.

options.title: Accept the new surface deliberately
options.body: Maintain core Rust launcher support with explicit packaging, upgrade, and ownership commitments despite the added toolchain and support surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow launcher redesign
recommendation.body: Keep the direction alive only if the branch is narrowed to launcher files, delegates configured readiness/version behavior, wires build/package support, forwards exact CLI args, and proves real flows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for dashboard readiness and the product-boundary setup direction this launcher changes.
